primary_window.end: earliest date of maximum positive observed WTEQ in the water year inclusive
primary_window.coverage: require complete climate and trace coverage from start through observed peak
primary_window.aggregation: compute annual values first, then Python statistics.median by site; do not pool water volume or weight sites by record length

precipitation_increment_operator.source: normalized observed_precip_mm, which is AWDB PREC water-year cumulative precipitation
precipitation_increment_operator.eligibility: current and previous records are consecutive calendar dates in the same water year and both are finite
precipitation_increment_operator.difference: current cumulative value minus previous cumulative value
precipitation_increment_operator.negative_policy: differences below -gauge_negative_tolerance_m are unavailable; values within tolerance canonicalize to zero
precipitation_increment_operator.prohibition: never bridge missing dates or water-year resets

mass_ceiling_operator.current_input_mass_ceiling_m: initial_swe_m + sum fixture all-phase .cli precipitation from window start through observed peak
mass_ceiling_operator.within_window_modeled_peak_m: maximum runtime_swe_after_m in the primary window, earliest date wins ties
mass_ceiling_operator.ratios: divide each magnitude by observed_peak_swe_m after computing the annual numerator
mass_ceiling_operator.site_signal: at least minimum_primary_years_per_site, site median current-input ceiling ratio < mass_ceiling_ratio_materiality, and at least site_direction_fraction of annual ratios < 1.0

cold_accumulation_events.active_day: consecutive observed WTEQ records have positive change >= observed_accumulation_event_threshold_m and observed_tmax_c <= 0 C on the current day
cold_accumulation_events.grouping: group consecutive active days; expand each group by one calendar day before and after for climate/trace timing allowance, clipped to the primary window; merge expanded intervals that overlap or touch
cold_accumulation_events.observed_gain: sum positive active-day WTEQ changes belonging to the merged event; padding-day changes are excluded
cold_accumulation_events.modeled_operands: sum fixture all-phase precipitation, modeled snowfall, rain retained, pack loss, and storage change across the expanded event interval
cold_accumulation_events.coverage: require every event interval day in climate and trace and every active-day observation operand; otherwise exclude with reason
cold_accumulation_events.site_all_phase_signal: at least minimum_cold_events_per_site, median event all-phase-input/observed-gain ratio < event_ratio_materiality, and at least event_direction_fraction of event ratios < event_ratio_materiality
cold_accumulation_events.phase_or_solid_input_signal: site all-phase signal is false while site snowfall signal is true; this does not uniquely identify phase
cold_accumulation_events.systemic: site signal at systemic_site_count or more sites

dry_intervals.active_day: fixture all-phase precipitation <= dry threshold, guarded observed precipitation increment <= dry threshold, observed WTEQ and Tmax are present, modeled and observed SWE are positive at interval entry, and date is in the primary window
dry_intervals.grouping: maximal consecutive active-day groups with at least minimum_dry_interval_days; groups are disjoint and may not cross water years
dry_intervals.observed_loss_m: max(observed WTEQ on day before interval minus observed WTEQ on final interval day, 0)
dry_intervals.modeled_pack_loss_m: sum authoritative snowpack_swe_loss_m over interval days
dry_intervals.modeled_storage_change_m: runtime_swe_after_m on final day minus runtime_swe_before_m on first day
dry_intervals.temperature_strata: cold when observed_tmax_c <= 0 C on every interval day; warm_or_mixed otherwise
dry_intervals.annual_aggregation: sum interval observed loss and modeled pack loss by site, water year, and all-temperature primary stratum; report cold stratum separately
dry_intervals.annual_difference_m: modeled pack loss minus observed WTEQ loss
dry_intervals.site_signal: at least minimum_dry_annuals_per_site, site median annual difference >= annual_dry_loss_difference_materiality_m, and at least site_direction_fraction of annual differences are positive
dry_intervals.systemic: site signal at systemic_site_count or more sites

truth_table.input_evidence: systemic current-input mass ceiling OR systemic cold-event all-phase-input signal OR systemic cold-event modeled-snowfall signal
truth_table.UNRESOLVED_OR_COVERAGE_LIMITED: neither evidence family passes or required coverage is unavailable

claim_limits: SNOTEL is a point observation and the fixtures are hillslope representations with elevation, canopy, footprint, and redistribution differences
PRCPSA incorporates WTEQ and is not independent validation or correction authority
cold-event modeled snowfall can confound forcing timing, phase, interception, and spatial representativeness
dry-interval differences can confound point-versus-hillslope energy, redistribution, gauge missingness, and timing
screen passage ranks evidence families but does not prove a correction equation or identify a parameter
no forcing, phase, loss-physics, observation, or default correction is authorized
